crime_description: Smuggling a shipment of illegal firearms across the border. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside customs official, financial motives, and offshore accounts.

suspect.name: Hector Mwangi
suspect.fake_alibi: Hector claims he was driving a legitimate shipment of agricultural supplies.

secrets.value: A corrupt customs official who waved Hector's truck through the checkpoint.
Hector owes a massive debt to a ruthless cartel.
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
